note: Made-up details for testing. Each case is one niche, written the way a user answers BUN's start question.

cases.name: invoice-follow-up
cases.idea: an automated invoice follow-up that saved a dental clinic hours of admin work
cases.details: The clinic has 3 admins. They chased unpaid invoices by hand for 6 hours a week. I built a flow that sends reminders on day 3, day 7, and day 14. Unpaid invoices went from 31 to 9 in 2 months.

cases.name: resume-skills-list
cases.idea: why a long skills list on a resume gets ignored
cases.details: I reviewed 40 resumes last month. 33 opened with a skills list of 6 lines or more. None of the 7 resumes that got interviews did. Those 7 all opened with one line about a result.

cases.name: demo-calls
cases.idea: why demo calls are lost in the first 8 minutes
cases.details: I listened to 25 recorded demos. In 19 of them the rep talked about features for 8 minutes before asking the buyer a question. Those 19 demos led to 2 closed deals. The other 6 demos led to 4 closed deals.

cases.name: emergency-fund-no-details
cases.idea: why a first-year earner needs an emergency fund before investing

cases.name: salary-range
cases.idea: why job posts with a salary range get more applicants
cases.details: My team posted two identical roles on the same day. The post with a salary range got 112 applicants in 14 days. The post without one got 47.
